name: 瑞幸咖啡
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=瑞幸咖啡
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = capi.lkcoffee.com, ecapi.lkcoffee.com, m.lkcoffee.com, img0*.luckincoffeecdn.com

[Rewrite]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capi\.lkcoffee\.com\/resource\/m\/sys\/app\/adposNew/i then response.body.replace(/\{.+\}/, "{\"status\":\"SUCCESS\"}")
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ec|c)api\.lkcoffee\.com\/resource\/m\/eorder\/product\/popAppTagProductList/i then response.body.mock("json", "{\"status\":\"SUCCESS\"}")
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/m\.lkcoffee\.com\/ecapi\/resource\/m\/member\/exchange\/page/i then response.body.replace(/\{.+\}/, "{\"status\":\"SUCCESS\"}")
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/m\.lkcoffee\.com\/capi\/resource\/m\/growUp\/main/i then response.body.replace(/"popTitle":".+?"/, "\"popTitle\":\"\"")
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img0[1-9]{1}\.luckincoffeecdn\.com\/group\d\/M00\/[A-Z0-9]{2}\/[A-Z0-9]{2}\/[a-zA-Z0-9]{29}\.(jpg|jpeg)_\.webp/i then reject(200)
